newsitem.title: USA: Ticketmaster to unveil golf venture - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Ticketmaster to unveil golf venture - WSJ.

text.p: Ticketmaster Group Inc wants its ticket-selling technology to be used for reserving golf course tee times, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition Wednesday.
The report said the company is targeting as many as 7,500 public-golf-course operators in the effort, which is scheduled to be announced today.
It said Ticketmaster Golf would charge each player 10 percent to 15 percent of the usual green fees for the service.

The project will be a joint venture with Golden Bear Golf Inc of North Palm Beach, Florida, a golf-products and services company whose chairman and largest shareholder is golfing legend Jack Nicklaus, the report said.
